data: Which of the following statements about the plot is true?

The learning curve shows an increase in F1 score with increasing percentage of training data. The F1 score starts at approximately 0.4 when 10% of the data is used for training and reaches around 0.6 when 90% of the data is used for training. The F1 score appears to plateau after approximately 70% of the data is used for training. The F1 score is represented by a blue line with circular markers.
